content.tex: A INVESTIGATION (QUESTIONS 1 TO 3)
SEQUENCES OF CENTRED POLYGONS (30 marks)
You are advised to spend no more than 50 minutes on this part.
This investigation looks at sequences of centred polygons. The first pattern in each sequence is a single dot. The sequence continues by adding polygons of increasing size around the central dot.
